proposals.evidence: CDIAL 55 agni lists L./P. agg/āg fire and MIA aggi/aggini. The simple survey ag/agh forms fit that family; learned agnī is identified with the Sanskrit word without asserting its local transmission history. Reviewed comparator: DewasDoneDanuwar agi “fire” (f_i4wezylxfvsku). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
